generator.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one clean environment background plate for bounded central hospital room stage in a survival strategy game. Generate exactly one new native 3840 x 2160 PNG, 16:9, without enlarging a smaller image. Subject H6: a small worn hospital staff on-call rest room, deserted. A narrow basic staff sleeping cot with a plain thin faded grey-green mattress rests against the back-left wall; simple bed legs, no medical mechanisms, no patient rails, no wheels, no IV stand. A single old empty wooden or steel chair is near the back-right wall. A small plain open cup-storage cabinet or cupboard on the right wall is visibly entirely empty, all shelves bare, no cups. No separate important props. Institutional desaturated teal-grey painted lower walls and worn off-white plaster above, cracked tired floor, subtle peeling paint, scuffed edges and age marks. One dim warm wall lamp above the cot provides a small amber pool; weak cold cyan-grey ambient light balances it, dark quiet blue-grey corners with readable midtones. Photorealistic cinematic game environment illustration, detailed realistic material texture, sober abandoned survivor atmosphere, clearly a staff rest room rather than a patient ward or luxurious bedroom. Camera eye-height, 28 mm wide stable near-frontal perspective, no dutch angle, no heavy depth-of-field blur; central 60% width contains the recognizable room layout, clean open central foreground floor with no props suitable for separate game action panel. Furniture should be small and held against walls, no major object at crop edges. No people, NPC, enemy, body, silhouette, human reflection, blood or gore. No HUD, UI, interface borders, icon, text, letters, words, numbers, labels, signage, hospital name, logos, watermarks, charts or medical diagram. No medical equipment, healing apparatus, first-aid supplies, medicines, bags, food, drinks, cups, bottles, tools, pickups, loot or rewards. Resting furniture is environmental set dressing only and must not imply automatic healing, free energy recovery or awarded supplies. Deliver one clean full-bleed native 3840x2160 PNG background.
